statements.verbatim_passage: Climate change also causes heat waves, and increased temperature can cause damage to and the failure of the finishing layers of buildings, i.e., cracks in housing panels, failure to roof coverings. The combined effect of temperature load with moisture can cause sudden damage to structures, creating cracks and scratches through which water may leak. It is particularly dangerous for old and historical buildings [8].
